name: Wayfarer's March
flavor: Left foot, right foot, live to count them. The party walks taller.

name: Fireheart Air
flavor: An old burning tune. Blades land heavier while it plays.

name: Lantern Reel
flavor: A bright quick reel that the dark dislikes. Light without flame.

name: Wardweaver's Knot
flavor: A knotted rhythm that catches trap-springs and curses alike.

name: Hearthsong Lull
flavor: A slow, warm air from before the gates were built. Wounds knit as you walk.

name: Confounding Jig
flavor: A tune with one beat too many. Enemies swing where you were.

name: Graveman's Dirge
flavor: The burying-song. The dead remember their graves and ache to return.
